operations.name: trajectory_single_changepoint_regions
operations.title: Single change-point regions along pseudotime
operations.description: Detect one interior L1 change point per matrix feature along an authenticated pseudotime axis in private Python compute, classify its direction from the mean signed difference across the boundary, aggregate breakpoint counts into an aligned density, and publish the features that exceed the density threshold inside each caller-declared directional rank window. Rank semantics are half-open and explicit; the notebook raw density convention is recorded in run_summary.

parameters.name: membership_compartment
parameters.help: Optional cell-vector compartment restricting the axis.

parameters.name: change_threshold
parameters.help: Density value at which a rank is significant.

parameters.name: non_finite_policy
parameters.help: Error or drop on non-finite input.

parameters.name: degenerate_bkp_policy
parameters.help: Error or drop when no interior breakpoint exists.

parameters.name: region_windows
parameters.help: Objects of region_id, direction, rank_start, rank_end; ranks are half-open [rank_start, rank_end). Omit to analyse the whole axis in both directions.
